  • টিকা দেওয়ার শিডিউল (৬, ১০, ১৪ সপ্তাহ): বাচ্চার বয়স ৬ সপ্তাহ, ১০ সপ্তাহ এবং ১৪ সপ্তাহ হলে ৩টি ডোজ দেওয়া হয় (প্রতিটি ডোজের মাঝে অন্তত ৪ সপ্তাহের ব্যবধান থাকতে হবে)।
  • ডোজ ও দেওয়ার জায়গা: ০.৫ মিলি মাংসে (IM)। বাম উরুর বাইরের দিকে (Left anterolateral thigh) দিতে হবে। বাচ্চার নিতম্বে (Buttock) ইনজেকশন দেওয়া সম্পূর্ণ নিষিদ্ধ কারণ সেখানে সায়াটিক নার্ভ ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হতে পারে!
  • কোল্ড চেইন সতর্কতা: এটি +২°সে থেকে +৮°সে তাপমাত্রায় রাখতে হয়; কখনোই বরফ জমানো যাবে না (Freeze-sensitive)।

435.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 19 (Environment and Health: Water Purification), pp. 815-832; WHO Guidelines for Drinking-water Quality 4th ed.
435.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | RAPID SAND FILTRATION & BREAKPOINT CHLORINATION | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [RAW WATER SOURCE (River / Reservoir)] | v [1. COAGULATION] ---> Rapid flash mix with ALUM (Aluminium sulfate, 10-40 mg/L). | v [2. FLOCCULATION] ---> Slow gentle paddle stirring (30 min) forms heavy, flocculent precipitate. | v [3. SEDIMENTATION] ---> Settling basins (2-6 hours); 95% of suspended matter & bacteria settle. | v [4. FILTRATION] ---> Rapid Sand Filter Beds (Rate: 4,000 - 7,500 L/m2/hour). | v [5. CHLORINATION] ---> Disinfection to reach BREAKPOINT CHLORINATION! +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [THE BREAKPOINT CHLORINATION CURVE] Residual Chlorine ^ /--- [FREE RESIDUAL CHLORINE] | / (HClO & ClO-) | /---\ / Kills bacteria in 30 mins! | / \ / | / \ / | / \--------------------/ | / ^ +----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------> Chlorine reacts BREAKPOINT: All ammonia, chloramines & reducing with ammonia -> substances completely destroyed! Point beyond forms chloramines. which added chlorine appears directly as FREE RESIDUAL! +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
435.answer:
1. Large-Scale Water Purification (Rapid Sand Filtration / Paterson's System): Rapid sand filtration is the modern, high-capacity engineering method of purifying surface water for urban municipal populations. It comprises five sequential stages:
  1. Stage 1: Coagulation (Flash Mixing): Raw water is treated with a chemical coagulant, most commonly Alum (Aluminum sulfate, $Al_2(SO_4)_3$) at a dosage of 10 to 40 mg/L depending on turbidity and pH. The water is agitated violently in a flash mixing chamber for 1-2 minutes to ensure rapid, uniform chemical dispersal.
  2. Stage 2: Flocculation: The treated water flows into a flocculation basin equipped with slowly rotating mechanical paddles (stirred gently for 30 minutes). Aluminum ions neutralize the negative surface charges of colloidal clay, silt, and bacterial particles, precipitating a thick, heavy, gelatinous floc of aluminum hydroxide: $$Al_2(SO_4)_3 + 3Ca(HCO_3)_2 \rightarrow 2Al(OH)_3 \downarrow + 3CaSO_4 + 6CO_2$$
  3. Stage 3: Sedimentation: The water enters continuous-flow sedimentation settling tanks where it remains undisturbed for 2 to 6 hours. The heavy flocs settle by gravity to the bottom as sludge, removing over 95% of suspended matter, turbidity, and bacteria.
  4. Stage 4: Rapid Sand Filtration: The clarified water is filtered through rapid sand filter beds (sand depth 1 meter, effective sand size 0.45-0.7 mm, underlaid with graded gravel).
    • Filtration Rate: Extremely high: 4,000 to 7,500 liters per square meter per hour (50 times faster than slow sand filters!).
    • Cleaning Method: Cleaned by Backwashing (forcing high-pressure compressed air and clean water upward through the filter bed for 10-15 minutes to dislodge trapped sediment).
  5. Stage 5: Disinfection (Chlorination): Filtered water is treated with chlorine gas ($Cl_2$) or liquid sodium hypochlorite to destroy all remaining pathogenic bacteria, viruses, and amoebic cysts.
2. Breakpoint Chlorination (Concept & Chemistry): Breakpoint Chlorination is the point at which the chlorine demand of the water has been completely satisfied, meaning all oxidizable organic matter, iron, sulfur, ammonia, and amines have been entirely oxidized; any chlorine added beyond this point exists as Free Available Residual Chlorine.
  • The 4 Phases of the Breakpoint Curve:
    1. Phase 1: Added chlorine is consumed instantly by inorganic reducing agents ($Fe^{2+}$, $Mn^{2+}$, $H_2S$); zero residual chlorine appears.
    2. Phase 2: Chlorine reacts with ammonia and amino acids to form Combined Residual Chlorine (monochloramine, dichloramine, nitrogen trichloride). The residual curve rises.
    3. Phase 3 (Destruction Phase): As more chlorine is added, it violently oxidizes and destroys the chloramines, releasing nitrogen gas ($N_2$). The combined chlorine concentration falls sharply to a minimum trough.
    4. Phase 4 (The Breakpoint & Beyond): This lowest dip is the BREAKPOINT. Beyond this point, all chloramines are eradicated; any further chlorine added appears directly as Free Residual Chlorine (Hypochlorous acid - $HOCl$, and hypochlorite ion - $OCl^-$), which possesses 25-100 times greater bactericidal potency than combined chlorine!
  • Public Health Standard for Drinking Water: Following chlorination, the water must have a Free Residual Chlorine concentration of at least 0.5 mg/L (0.5 ppm) after a minimum contact time of 1 hour at pH < 8.0 to protect against re-contamination in municipal supply pipelines.
435.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • বড় পরিসরে পানি বিশুদ্ধকরণ (Rapid Sand Filtration-এর ৫টি ধাপ):
    1. Coagulation: পানিতে ফিটকিরি (Alum) মিশিয়ে তীব্রভাবে নাড়ানো।
    2. Flocculation: ধীরে ধীরে নেড়ে ময়লা ও জীবাণুকে আঠার মতো ভারী পিণ্ডে (Floc) পরিণত করা।
    3. Sedimentation: ভারী ময়লা নিচে থিতিয়ে পড়া (২-৬ ঘণ্টা)। ৯৫% ময়লা এখানেই পরিষ্কার হয়।
    4. Filtration: দ্রুতগতির বালির ফিল্টারে ফিল্টার করা (ঘণ্টায় ৪,০০০-৭,৫০০ লিটার/বর্গমিটার)। এটি পরিষ্কার করা হয় উল্টোদিক থেকে পানি ও বাতাস মেরে (Backwashing)।
    5. Chlorination: জীবাণুমুক্ত করতে ক্লোরিন মেশানো।
  • Breakpoint Chlorination (ব্রেকপয়েন্ট ক্লোরিনেশন): পানিতে ক্লোরিন দিলে প্রথমে তা ময়লা ও অ্যামোনিয়া ধ্বংস করে। এক পর্যায়ে সব ময়লা ধ্বংস হয়ে শেষ হয়—যে পয়েন্টে পৌঁছালে ময়লা শেষ হয়ে অতিরিক্ত ক্লোরিন মুক্ত অবস্থায় (Free Residual Chlorine) পানিতে থেকে যায়, তাকে Breakpoint বলে।
    গোল্ডেন মান: পাইপলাইনের পানিতে ০.৫ মিগ্রা/লিটার (0.5 ppm) ফ্রি ক্লোরিন অন্তত ১ ঘণ্টা থাকতে হবে যাতে পাইপে নতুন করে জীবাণু জন্মাতে না পারে।

436.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 19 (Environmental Health: Arsenicosis), pp. 838-842; DGHS National Policy for Arsenic Mitigation & Guidelines for Clinical Management of Arsenicosis in Bangladesh.
436.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | CLINICAL PROGRESSION OF CHRONIC ARSENICOSIS | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [CHRONIC INGESTION OF HIGH-ARSENIC GROUNDWATER] (> 0.05 mg/L for 5-10 years) | v [STAGE 1: PRE-CLINICAL] ---> Asymptomatic; arsenic detected in hair, nails & urine. | v [STAGE 2: CLINICAL / DERMIC] * Melanosis: "Raindrop pigmentation" on trunk/chest; Leucomelanosis. * Keratosis: Rough, nodular thickening on palms and soles ("Spotted palm"). | v [STAGE 3: COMPLICATION / VASCULAR] * Severe Keratosis (diffuse crusty thickening), Hepatomegaly, Chronic Bronchitis. * "Blackfoot Disease" / Peripheral vascular gangrene due to Raynaud's endarteritis. | v [STAGE 4: MALIGNANCY] * Cutaneous: Bowen's disease, Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC), Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC). * Internal Visceral: Bladder carcinoma, Lung cancer, Hepatic angiosarcoma! +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
436.answer:
1. The Arsenic Crisis in Bangladesh: Arsenic contamination of shallow tube-well groundwater in Bangladesh is described by the WHO as "the largest mass poisoning of a population in human history", exposing an estimated 35-40 million people across 61 districts (worst affected: Chandpur, Cumilla, Noakhali, Gopalganj, Faridpur, Munshiganj). 2. Permissible Limits of Arsenic in Drinking Water:
  • WHO Guideline Standard (Global): 0.01 mg/L (10 $\mu g$/L or 10 ppb).
  • Bangladesh National Standard: 0.05 mg/L (50 $\mu g$/L or 50 ppb) (adopted due to technical and economic constraints in groundwater mitigation).
3. Clinical Stages of Chronic Arsenicosis (DGHS Classification): Arsenicosis manifests after a latency period of 5 to 15 years of chronic ingestion:
  1. Stage 1: Pre-Clinical Stage: No visible dermatological manifestations. Arsenic accumulation can only be detected chemically in biological tissues: Hair (> 1 mg/kg), Nails (> 1.5 mg/kg), or 24-hour Urine (> 50 $\mu g$/L).
  2. Stage 2: Clinical Stage (Dermatological Hallmarks - Pathognomonic):
    • Melanosis: Symmetrical diffuse hyperpigmentation on the trunk, chest, and back, classically presenting as dark-spotted pigmentation punctuated by white depigmented macules described as "Raindrop pigmentation" on the skin (Leucomelanosis). Mucous membrane melanosis (tongue, gums).
    • Keratosis: Bilateral symmetrical nodular thickening and roughness on the palms and soles (Palmar and Plantar keratosis). Begins as tiny raised papules ("gritty sensation") and progresses to hard, rough, elevated nodules.
  3. Stage 3: Complication Stage:
    • Severe, diffuse, fissured, crusty keratosis causing painful walking and hand deformities.
    • Non-cirrhotic portal fibrosis with hepatomegaly and splenomegaly.
    • Chronic lung disease: Persistent cough, chronic bronchitis, bronchiectasis.
    • Peripheral Vascular Disease ("Blackfoot Disease"): Non-atherosclerotic thromboangiitis and endarteritis obliterans leading to cold extremities, Raynaud's phenomenon, ischemic ulceration, and dry gangrene of feet/toes.
    • Arsenical polyneuropathy: Distal symmetrical stocking-and-glove sensorimotor neuropathy.
  4. Stage 4: Malignancy Stage: Arsenic is an established Class I human carcinogen.
    • Cutaneous Malignancies: Bowen's disease (carcinoma in situ), multiple Squamous Cell Carcinomas (SCC), and Basal Cell Carcinomas (BCC) arising in areas of keratosis.
    • Internal Visceral Malignancies: Urinary bladder transitional cell carcinoma, Bronchogenic carcinoma of the lung, Renal cell carcinoma, and Hepatic angiosarcoma.
4. Preventive & Mitigation Measures:
  • Provision of Safe Water Alternatives (Top Priority):
    1. Deep Tube-Wells: Sinking deep tube-wells (> 150-250 meters / > 500 feet) into deep Pleistocene aquifers that are universally arsenic-free.
    2. Piped Water Systems: Treated surface water distribution.
    3. Rainwater Harvesting: Rooftop collection systems during monsoon months.
    4. Sanitary Dug Wells & Pond Sand Filters (PSF): Utilizing filtered surface water.
  • Tube-Well Screening & Color-Coding (National Campaign): Testing tube-wells with field test kits and painting the pump head:
    • GREEN PUMP: Arsenic $\le$ 0.05 mg/L $\rightarrow$ Safe for drinking and cooking.
    • RED PUMP: Arsenic > 0.05 mg/L $\rightarrow$ Unsafe for drinking/cooking; banned for human consumption.
  • Household Arsenic Removal Filters: Sono 3-kolshi filter, Read-F filter, Alcan filter.
  • Medical Management: Provide safe drinking water immediately (stops progression and reverses early melanosis); Antioxidants: Vitamin A, C, E, and Selenium; Topical 20% Salicylic acid or 10% Urea ointment for thick keratotic plaques.
436.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • পানিতে আর্সেনিকের নিরাপদ মাত্রা (এমসিকিউ গোল্ডেন প্রশ্ন):
    • WHO মান: ০.০১ মিলিগ্রাম/লিটার (10 ppb)।
    • বাংলাদেশ মান: ০.০৫ মিলিগ্রাম/লিটার (50 ppb)।
  • আর্সেনিকোসিসের প্রধান ক্লিনিক্যাল স্টেজ ও লক্ষণ:
    1. Melanosis: বুকে-পিঠে বৃষ্টির ফোঁটার মতো কালচে ও সাদাটে ছোপ ছোপ দাগ—যাকে "Raindrop pigmentation" বলে।
    2. Keratosis: হাতের তালু ও পায়ের তলা খসখসে শক্ত ও কড়া পড়া দানাদার হয়ে যাওয়া (Spotted palms & soles)।
    3. Blackfoot Disease: পায়ের রক্তনালী বন্ধ হয়ে পচন বা গ্যাংগ্রিন হয়ে যাওয়া।
    4. Malignancy: ত্বক, ফুসফুস এবং প্রস্রাবের থলির (Bladder) ক্যান্সার হওয়া।
  • প্রতিরোধের ব্যবস্থা: লাল রঙের টিউবওয়েল মানে আর্সেনিক বেশি (পান করা নিষিদ্ধ); সবুজ রঙের টিউবওয়েল মানে নিরাপদ। গভীর নলকূপ (৫০০ ফুটের বেশি গভীর), বৃষ্টির পানি সংরক্ষণ (Rainwater harvesting) এবং অ্যান্টিঅক্সিডেন্ট (ভিটামিন এ, সি, ই) খাওয়া।

437.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 19 (Hospital Waste Management), pp. 848-854; Bangladesh Medical Waste (Management and Processing) Rules 2008; WHO Health-care Waste Management Guidelines.
437.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | BIOMEDICAL WASTE MANAGEMENT: COLOR-CODED SEGREGATION | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [POINT OF GENERATION SEGREGATION (NEVER MIX AT SOURCE!)] | +------------+------------+------------+------------+ | | | | [YELLOW BIN] [RED BIN] [BLUE BIN] [BLACK BIN] * Anatomical waste: * Recyclable infected * Glassware, ampoules, * General non-infectious placenta, amputated plastics: IV tubes, vials, metallic sharps, municipal waste: food, tissues, body parts. cannulae, catheters, scalpel blades, needles paper, fruit peels, * Soiled gauze, pus swabs. urine bags, gloves. in puncture-proof box! empty packaging. | | | | v v v v [INCINERATION / [AUTOCLAVING / [DISINFECTION / [MUNICIPAL DEEP BURIAL PIT] SHREDDING & RECYCLE] ENCASED CONCRETE PIT] LANDFILL DUMP] +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
437.answer:
1. Definition & Core Principle: Biomedical Waste (Health-care Waste) is any waste generated during the diagnosis, treatment, or immunization of human beings or animals, or in research activities. Approximately 85% is general non-hazardous waste and 15% is hazardous infectious/toxic waste.
The Cardinal Golden Rule: Segregation at the point of generation is the most critical step; once hazardous waste mixes with general waste, the entire bulk becomes hazardous! 2. Color-Coded Waste Disposal Bin System (Bangladesh National Standards):
Bin Color Category of Biomedical Waste Examples of Items Final Treatment & Disposal Method
YELLOW (Infectious Anatomical & Soiled) Human anatomical waste, animal waste, items contaminated with blood/body fluids, soiled cotton/gauze, expired cytotoxic drugs. Placenta, amputated limbs, biopsy tissues, blood bags, pus-soaked dressings, cast bandages. High-temperature Incineration (> 1000°C) or Deep Burial in lined concrete pits.
RED (Infected Recyclable Plastics) Contaminated recyclable plastic and rubber medical consumables. IV fluid tubing, drip sets, blood transfusion sets, urinary Foley catheters, endotracheal tubes, plastic gloves, syringes (without needle). Autoclaving / Hydroclaving $\rightarrow$ Shredding $\rightarrow$ Industrial recycling (non-food grade).
BLUE (Sharps & Glassware) All metallic and glass sharps; rigid puncture-proof, tamper-proof containers. Disposable injection needles, scalpels, surgical blades, lancets, glass ampoules, medicine vials, broken slides. Chemical disinfection (1% Sodium Hypochlorite) or Autoclaving $\rightarrow$ Sharp pit encapsulation in concrete.
BLACK (General Non-Infectious) Non-hazardous, non-infectious general municipal hospital refuse. Paper wrappers, medicine cartons, food leftovers, vegetable/fruit peels, water bottles, office stationery. City Corporation municipal solid waste collection and sanitary landfilling.
3. Final Disposal Technologies:
  • Incineration: Controlled high-temperature thermal oxidation process carried out in dual-chamber incinerators (Primary chamber: 800°C $\pm$ 50°C; Secondary chamber: 1050°C $\pm$ 50°C). Converts anatomical and pathological waste into sterile non-combustible ash, reducing volume by 95%. Rule: Never incinerate PVC plastics (emits toxic dioxins/furans).
  • Autoclaving: High-pressure steam thermal sterilization (typically 121°C at 15 psi for 45-60 minutes, or 134°C at 30 psi for 30 minutes). Completely inactivates vegetative bacteria, mycobacteria, spores, and viruses in recyclable plastic and sharp wastes.
  • Deep Burial Pit: Approved low-cost method for rural Upazila Health Complexes without incinerators. A trench 2 meters deep is dug, lined with impervious clay or masonry; waste is filled up to 1.5 meters, covered with a layer of quicklime (50 cm), and backfilled with soil to prevent dog/scavenger exhumation.
437.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • হাসপাতালের বর্জ্য ব্যবস্থাপনা (Color-coded Bins - মুখস্থ চার্ট):
    1. হলুদ বালতি (Yellow): মানুষের অঙ্গপ্রত্যঙ্গ, গর্ভফুল (Placenta), পুঁজ বা রক্তমাখা গজ-ব্যান্ডেজ ও পুরনো ওষুধ। এগুলো ইনসিনারেটরে পুড়িয়ে বা গভীর গর্তে পুঁতে (Deep burial) নষ্ট করা হয়।
    2. লাল বালতি (Red): প্লাস্টিকের সংক্রামক জিনিস—স্যালাইনের পাইপ, ক্যাথেটার, ব্লাড ব্যাগ, প্লাস্টিক সিরিঞ্জ (সূঁচ ছাড়া) ও গ্লাভস। এগুলোকে অটোক্লেভ (Autoclave) করে জীবাণুমুক্ত করার পর রিসাইকেল করা হয়।
    3. নীল বালতি / শার্প বক্স (Blue): ধারালো সূঁচ, ব্লেড, কাঁচের অ্যাম্পুল ও ভায়াল। এগুলো সোডিয়াম হাইপোক্লোরাইটে ভিজিয়ে কংক্রিটের শার্প পিটে (Sharp Pit) সিলগালা করা হয়।
    4. কালো বালতি (Black): সাধারণ গৃহস্থালি ময়লা—কাগজ, ফলের খোসা, খাবারের উচ্ছিষ্ট। সাধারণ ডাস্টবিনে ফেলা হয়।
  • সবচেয়ে জরুরি নীতি: বর্জ্য তৈরির জায়গায় (পয়েন্ট অব জেনারেশন) রঙ অনুযায়ী আলাদা ফেলা বাধ্যতামূলক। একবার মিশে গেলে পুরো সাধারণ ময়লা সংক্রামক বর্জ্যে পরিণত হয়!

438.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 19 (Purification of Water on Small Scale), pp. 832-835; WHO Household Water Treatment and Safe Storage Guidelines.
438.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | HOUSEHOLD WATER PURIFICATION MODALITIES | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [RAW DOMESTIC WATER] | +-------------------------------+-------------------------------+ | | | [1. BOILING (Physical)] [2. CHEMICAL CHLORINATION] [3. SODIS (Solar Disinfection)] * Rolling boil for * Halazone / Sodium * Clear PET plastic bottles 10 to 20 minutes! Dichloroisocyanurate (NaDCC). filled with low-turbidity water. * Destroys 100% bacteria, * 1 tablet (e.g. 33-67 mg) * Placed horizontally on black viruses, cysts, ova. per 10-20 Liters. rooftop under full sun for 6 HOURS! * Alters taste (aeration * Contact time: 30-60 MINS * Synergistic UV-A + Thermal restores palatability). before consumption! pasteurization (> 50 deg C). +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
438.answer:
1. Overview of Small-Scale / Household Water Purification: In rural settings, post-disaster flood conditions, and households lacking municipal pipeline water, domestic point-of-use water purification is essential to eliminate enteropathogens causing cholera, typhoid, and rotaviral diarrhea. 2. The Three Primary Household Modalities:
  1. Boiling (The Most Reliable Physical Method):
    • Procedure: Water must be brought to a vigorous, "rolling boil" for 10 to 20 minutes.
    • Efficacy: The gold standard of domestic water disinfection. Completely destroys all pathogenic bacteria, bacterial spores, enteroviruses (Hepatitis A and E, Polio), protozoal cysts (Giardia lamblia, Entamoeba histolytica), and helminthic ova.
    • Hardness & Taste: Removes temporary hardness by precipitating calcium and magnesium carbonates. The flat taste caused by expelling dissolved oxygen can be corrected by briskly shaking or aerating the water. Store in the same boiling vessel covered with a clean lid.
  2. Chemical Chlorination (Halazone & Chlorine Tablets):
    • Agents: Bleaching powder (Chlorinated lime), Halazone tablets, and modern Sodium Dichloroisocyanurate (NaDCC / Aquatabs) tablets.
    • Dosage & Action:
      • One standard NaDCC / Halazone tablet (typically releasing 2 to 5 mg/L available chlorine) is dissolved per 10 to 20 liters of clear water.
      • In flood emergencies, 1 chlorine tablet per water pitcher (Kolshi / 10-15 L).
    • Mandatory Contact Time: Minimum of 30 to 60 minutes contact time must be allowed before drinking to allow hypochlorous acid ($HOCl$) to lyse microbial membranes! Turbid floodwater must be strained through a clean multi-folded cotton cloth before chlorination.
  3. Solar Water Disinfection (SODIS): A simple, zero-cost, environmentally friendly household method approved by WHO:
    • Procedure: Clear, transparent polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic beverage bottles (1 to 2 liter capacity) are washed, filled with clear water (turbidity < 30 NTU), capped tightly, and placed horizontally on a corrugated iron roof or black surface in direct sunlight.
    • Exposure Time: Exposed to full direct sunshine for at least 6 consecutive hours (or for 2 full days if skies are more than 50% cloudy).
    • Bactericidal Mechanism: Synergistic dual action:
      1. Solar UV-A Radiation (wavelength 320-400 nm): Generates reactive oxygen species (free radicals) that damage microbial DNA and cell membranes.
      2. Thermal Pasteurization: Solar thermal energy heats the water above 50°C to 55°C, multiplying the pathogen kill rate by 3-fold.
438.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • বাসা-বাড়িতে পানি বিশুদ্ধকরণের ৩টি প্রধান পদ্ধতি:
    1. পানি ফুটানো (Boiling - সেরা পদ্ধতি): টগবগ করে ফোটার পর অন্তত ১০ থেকে ২০ মিনিট ধরে ফুটাতে হবে। এতে ব্যাকটেরিয়া, ভাইরাস এবং আমাশয়ের সিস্ট ও কৃমির ডিম সব ১০০% ধ্বংস হয়ে যায়। ফুটানোর পর পানি নাড়াচাড়া করে বাতাস ঢুকিয়ে দিলে পানসে স্বাদ দূর হয়।
    2. পানি বিশুদ্ধকরণ বড়ি (Halazone / NaDCC / ক্লোরিন ট্যাবলেট): বন্যা বা দুর্যোগের সময় ১ কলস পানিতে (১০-২০ লিটার) ১টি ট্যাবলেট দিয়ে অন্তত ৩০ মিনিট থেকে ১ ঘণ্টা অপেক্ষা করতে হবে (Contact time)। সাথে সাথে খেলে কোনো কাজ হবে না!
    3. সোলার ওয়াটার ডিজইনফেকশন (SODIS): স্বচ্ছ প্লাস্টিকের বোতলে পরিষ্কার পানি ভরে টিনের চালের উপর কড়া রোদে কমপক্ষে ৬ ঘণ্টা রেখে দিলে সূর্যের আল্ট্রাভায়োলেট রশ্মি (UV-A) এবং ৫০°সে তাপমাত্রায় সব জীবাণু মরে যায় (বিনা খরচের পদ্ধতি)।

439.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 19 (Disposal of Wastes: Excreta Disposal), pp. 842-848; UNICEF / DGHS Guidelines on Community Sanitation.
439.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | SANITARY WATER-SEAL (POUR-FLUSH) LATRINE ARCHITECTURE | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [SQUATTING PAN (Porcelain / Smooth Cement)] (Steep 25-30 deg slope facilitates self-cleansing) | v [THE WATER SEAL (P-TRAP / U-TRAP)] <-- 20 mm (2 cm) Water Barrier! (Blocks odor, gases, flies & mosquitoes!) | v (Connecting PVC Pipe, 7.5-10 cm dia, 1:30 slope) [LEACHING PIT / SOAK PIT] - 1 to 1.5 m diameter, 1.5 to 2.5 m deep. - Honeycomb honeycomb brick lining (allows liquid effluent to seep into soil). - Strict rule: Minimum 15 METERS away from any drinking water tube-well! +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
439.answer:
1. Definition & Public Health Essence: A Sanitary Latrine (specifically the Pour-Flush Water-Seal Latrine) is an excreta disposal facility that isolates human feces safely, preventing the contamination of surface soil, groundwater, and food, and preventing flies and animals from accessing the excreta.
The "F-Diagram" Interruption: Sanitary latrines break the fecal-oral disease transmission web across all vectors: Feces $\rightarrow$ Fluids, Fingers, Flies, Fields, and Food. 2. Essential Components of a Pour-Flush Water-Seal Latrine:
  1. Squatting Pan: Made of glazed ceramic, porcelain, or smooth impervious cement. Designed with a steep slope (25° to 30°) and integrated footrests on either side to facilitate rapid cleansing with only 1.5 to 2 liters of flush water.
  2. The Water-Seal (The P-Trap or Gooseneck): The core sanitary engineering breakthrough of the latrine:
    • A curved pipe (U-trap or P-trap) retaining a permanent column of standing water measuring at least 20 mm (2 cm) in depth between the pan outlet and the pit pipe.
    • Functions: Provides a complete, impermeable physical barrier that:
      1. Completely blocks foul sewer gases (hydrogen sulfide, methane) from backing up into the latrine house.
      2. Prevents flies, cockroaches, and mosquitoes from entering the pit to feed on feces and returning to contaminate kitchen food.
  3. Connecting Pipe: A smooth PVC or stoneware pipe (75 to 100 mm diameter) connecting the water-seal trap to the leaching pit, laid with a minimum downward gradient of 1:30.
  4. The Leaching Pit (Soak Pit / Ring Pit): A circular pit (1 to 1.2 meters diameter, 1.5 to 2.5 meters deep) lined with precast concrete rings or honeycomb brickwork with open vertical joints. Liquid effluent percolates safely into the surrounding soil where biological digestion occurs, while solid sludge settles, digests anaerobically, and consolidates.
  5. Superstructure: Surrounding walls and roof providing privacy, dignity, and weather protection.
3. Mandatory Siting Criteria (Distance from Tube-Wells): The pit must be located at a minimum horizontal distance of 15 meters (50 feet) from any drinking water tube-well or water source, and situated downhill/down-gradient from the well to prevent bacterial leaching into the drinking water aquifer. 4. Major Health Benefits:
  • Dramatically reduces the incidence of water-borne and fecal-oral diarrheal diseases (Cholera, Typhoid, Bacillary dysentery, Rotavirus, Hepatitis A & E) by 30-40%.
  • Eliminates soil-transmitted helminthiases (Roundworm/Ascaris, Hookworm/Ancylostoma, Whipworm/Trichuris), reducing childhood iron-deficiency anemia and stunting.
  • Prevents eye infections (Trachoma) by eliminating fly breeding.
  • Provides personal safety, privacy, and security for rural women and adolescent girls.
439.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • Sanitary Latrine (ওয়াটার-সিল ল্যাট্রিন)-এর উপাদান:
    1. Squatting Pan: মসৃণ প্যান যা সামান্য পানি (১.৫-২ লিটার) ঢাললেই পরিষ্কার হয়ে যায়।
    2. Water Seal (ওয়াটার সিল - সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অংশ): প্যানের নিচে ইংরেজি 'U' বা 'P' আকৃতির বাঁকানো পাইপ যেখানে কমপক্ষে ২০ মিলিমিটার (২ সেমি) পানি সবসময় জমে থাকে।
      কাজ: এটি দুর্গন্ধ ও মিথেন গ্যাস উপরে উঠতে দেয় না এবং মাছি বা মশা ভেতরে ঢুকে মল থেকে জীবাণু এনে খাবারের উপর ছড়াতে পারে না।
    3. Leaching Pit (রিং-স্ল্যাব পিট): মাটির নিচে কংক্রিটের রিং বসানো গর্ত যেখানে তরল অংশ মাটিতে চুইয়ে যায় এবং কঠিন অংশ পচে সার হয়।
  • টিউবওয়েল থেকে নিরাপদ দূরত্ব (পরীক্ষার হট প্রশ্ন): পায়খানার গর্ত অবশ্যই খাবার পানির নলকূপ থেকে কমপক্ষে ১৫ মিটার (৫০ ফুট) দূরে এবং নলকূপের চেয়ে নিচু ঢালে স্থাপন করতে হবে, যাতে ভূগর্ভস্থ পানি দূষিত না হয়।

440.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 19 (Air Pollution), pp. 805-815; WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines 2021; Bangladesh Department of Environment (DoE).
440.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | PARTICULATE MATTER (PM) SCALE & PENETRATION DEPTH | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [HUMAN HAIR: ~50 - 70 micrometers diameter] | v [PM10 (Coarse Particles: <= 10 micrometers)] * Dust, pollen, mold, construction debris. * Trapped in upper airway: nose, pharynx, trachea & main bronchi -> Asthma, chronic bronchitis. | v [PM2.5 (Fine Particles: <= 2.5 micrometers)] * Brick kilns, diesel exhaust, vehicular combustion, chemical smoke. * PENETRATES DEEP INTO ALVEOLI -> Crosses alveolar-capillary membrane into systemic circulation! * Triggers systemic inflammation, atherosclerosis, Acute MI, Ischemic Stroke & Lung Cancer! +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
440.answer:
1. Major Sources of Air Pollution in Bangladesh: Air quality in urban Bangladesh (particularly Dhaka, ranked among the world's most polluted cities) is driven by:
  1. Brick Kilns: Thousands of traditional fixed-chimney brick kilns operating around major cities burning low-grade coal and biomass (contributes 35-50% of Dhaka's dry-season fine particulate pollution).
  2. Vehicular Emissions: High density of old diesel trucks, buses, two-stroke engines emitting black carbon, nitrogen oxides ($NO_x$), and unburned hydrocarbons.
  3. Construction Dust & Unpaved Roads: Massive uncoordinated civil infrastructure projects generating enormous coarse dust.
  4. Industrial Emissions & Waste Burning: Textile mills, chemical plants, and open burning of municipal solid plastic garbage.
  5. Transboundary Pollution: Regional aerosol drift from the Indo-Gangetic Plain during winter inversion months.
2. Health Impacts of Particulate Matter ($PM_{10}$ and $PM_{2.5}$): Particulate matter (PM) is classified based on aerodynamic diameter:
  • $PM_{10}$ (Coarse Inhalable Particles, diameter $\le$ 10 $\mu m$): Deposited predominantly in the upper respiratory tract (nasopharynx, trachea, and large bronchi). Triggers mucosal irritation, acute exacerbation of asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), allergic rhinitis, and recurrent bronchitis.
  • $PM_{2.5}$ (Fine Particles, diameter $\le$ 2.5 $\mu m$ - THE DEADLIEST POLLUTANT): Due to their microscopic size (1/30th the width of a human hair), $PM_{2.5}$ particles bypass the ciliated mucociliary escalator, penetrate into the deepest terminal bronchioles and alveoli, and cross the alveolar-capillary membrane directly into the bloodstream!
    • Cardiovascular Effects: Causes chronic systemic endothelial inflammation, oxidative stress, plaque instability, acute myocardial infarction, arrhythmias, and ischemic stroke.
    • Pulmonary Effects: Accelerated lung function decline, emphysema, pulmonary fibrosis, and Class I human carcinogenesis (Lung Adenocarcinoma).
    • Perinatal & Pediatric Effects: Maternal exposure causes low birth weight (LBW), preterm birth, intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), and impaired cognitive brain development in young children.
3. Air Quality Index (AQI): The Air Quality Index is a standardized daily numerical scale developed by the EPA and adopted by the Bangladesh Department of Environment (DoE) that transforms complex pollutant concentrations ($PM_{2.5}, PM_{10}, O_3, NO_2, SO_2, CO$) into a simple color-coded metric reflecting public health risk:
AQI Value Category / Color Health Advisory
0 to 50 Good (Green) Air quality is satisfactory; zero risk.
51 to 100 Moderate (Yellow) Acceptable; mild concern for unusually sensitive people.
101 to 150 Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups (Orange) Children, elderly, asthmatics suffer symptoms; general public unaffected.
151 to 200 Unhealthy (Red) Everyone begins to experience health effects; sensitive groups suffer severe issues.
201 to 300 Very Unhealthy (Purple) Health alert: Entire population at serious risk; avoid outdoor activities.
> 300 Hazardous (Maroon) Health emergency: Severe respiratory & cardiovascular crisis; mandatory N95 masks, stay indoors!
440.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • বাংলাদেশে বায়ুদূষণের প্রধান উৎস: অবৈধ ইটের ভাটা (সবচেয়ে বড় কারণ), পুরনো ফিটনেসবিহীন ডিজেল চালিত গাড়ির ধোঁয়া এবং রাস্তা ও কনস্ট্রাকশনের ধুলাবালি।
  • $PM_{10}$ vs $PM_{2.5}$ (কণিকা দূষণ):
    • $PM_{10}$ (বড় কণা): শ্বাসনালীর উপরের অংশে আটকে যায় $\rightarrow$ কাশি, হাঁপানি ও ব্রংকাইটিস ঘটায়।
    • $PM_{2.5}$ (অতি ক্ষুদ্র কণা - সবচেয়ে মারাত্মক): মানুষের চুলের চেয়ে ৩০ গুণ সরু! এটি ফুসফুসের একদম শেষ প্রান্ত (Alveoli) ভেদ করে সরাসরি রক্তের স্রোতে মিশে যায়। ফলে হার্ট অ্যাটাক, স্ট্রোক, ফুসফুসের ক্যান্সার এবং গর্ভস্থ বাচ্চার ওজন কমে যায়।
  • AQI (এয়ার কোয়ালিটি ইনডেক্স): বাতাসের মান নির্দেশক স্কোর: ০-৫০ (Good), ১৫১-২০০ (Unhealthy - অস্বাস্থ্যকর), ২০১-৩০০ (Very unhealthy) এবং > ৩০০ মানে Hazardous (বিপজ্জনক জরুরি অবস্থা)। শীতকালে ঢাকার AQI প্রায়ই ৩০০ পার হয়ে যায়!

441.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 5 (Epidemiology of Communicable Diseases: Tuberculosis), pp. 195-215; National Tuberculosis Control Programme (NTP) Bangladesh Guidelines 6th ed., DGHS.
441.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | NATIONAL TB CONTROL PROGRAMME (NTP) BANGLADESH WORKFLOW | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [PRESUMPTIVE TB CASE: Cough >= 2 weeks, fever, night sweats, weight loss] | v [PRIMARY MOLECULAR DIAGNOSIS: GeneXpert MTB/RIF (Truenat)] * Ultra-rapid automated Real-Time PCR (Result within 2 hours!). * Detects: (1) Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) DNA. (2) Rifampicin Resistance (mutation in rpoB gene). | +---------------------------+---------------------------+ | | [RIFAMPICIN SENSITIVE TB] [RIFAMPICIN RESISTANT (MDR-TB)] * 6-Month Standard DOTS Regimen: * Refer to Specialized MDR-TB Centre (NIDCH). - Intensive Phase: 2 HRZE (2 months). * Shorter All-Oral Bedaquiline-based Regimen - Continuation Phase: 4 HR (4 months). (Bedaquiline, Linezolid, Levofloxacin). | v [STANDARDIZED TREATMENT OUTCOMES EVALUATION (WHO / NTP)] Cured | Treatment Completed | Treatment Failed | Died | Lost to Follow-up | Not Evaluated +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
441.answer:
1. Background & The DOTS Strategy in Bangladesh: Bangladesh ranks among the 30 high TB burden countries globally. The National Tuberculosis Control Programme (NTP) operates under the Directly Observed Treatment Short-course (DOTS) strategy, achieving treatment success rates > 95% nationwide.
Five Core Pillars of DOTS:
  1. Sustained political and financial commitment.
  2. Early case detection through quality-assured molecular biology and bacteriology.
  3. Standardized supervised treatment with patient support (Direct observation of drug ingestion).
  4. Uninterrupted supply of quality-assured anti-TB drugs.
  5. Standardized recording and reporting system enabling cohort outcome analysis.
2. Modern Case Finding Algorithm (GeneXpert / Truenat): NTP Bangladesh has phased out simple sputum microscopy as the primary diagnostic tool, designating GeneXpert MTB/RIF (and Truenat) as the initial diagnostic test for all presumptive TB cases:
  • Technology: Cartridge-based automated real-time nested PCR assay.
  • Turnaround Time: Provides definitive results within 2 hours.
  • Dual Diagnostic Capability:
    1. Simultaneously detects the DNA of Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex with ultra-high sensitivity (detects as few as 130 bacilli/mL).
    2. Simultaneously detects Rifampicin resistance by identifying mutations in the 81-base pair core region of the bacterial rpoB gene (the key surrogate marker for Multidrug-Resistant TB / MDR-TB).
3. Standard Treatment Regimens:
  • Drug-Susceptible TB (Cat-I Regimen, 6 Months Duration):
    • Intensive Phase (2 Months - 2 HRZE): Daily fixed-dose combination (FDC) of Isoniazid (H), Rifampicin (R), Pyrazinamide (Z), and Ethambutol (E).
    • Continuation Phase (4 Months - 4 HR): Daily FDC of Isoniazid (H) and Rifampicin (R).
  • MDR-TB (Rifampicin Resistant): Managed using standardized all-oral regimens containing novel agents: Bedaquiline, Linezolid, Levofloxacin/Moxifloxacin, and Clofazimine (BPaL/BPaLM regimens).
4. WHO / NTP Standardized Treatment Outcome Definitions:
Treatment Outcome Official WHO / NTP Operational Definition
1. Cured A pulmonary TB patient with bacteriologically confirmed TB at the beginning of treatment who was smear- or culture-negative in the last month of treatment and on at least one previous occasion.
2. Treatment Completed A patient who completed treatment according to national protocol, but whose sputum smear or culture results are not available in the last month of treatment.
3. Treatment Failed A patient whose sputum smear or culture is positive at month 5 or later during treatment.
4. Died A patient who dies from any reason before starting or during the course of treatment.
5. Lost to Follow-up (Defaulted) A patient whose treatment was interrupted for 2 consecutive months or more.
6. Not Evaluated A patient for whom no treatment outcome is assigned (e.g., transferred out to another district without records returned).
Treatment Success Rate = (Cured + Treatment Completed) / Total Cohort Registered $\times 100$.
441.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • জাতীয় যক্ষ্মা নিয়ন্ত্রণ কর্মসূচি (NTP) ও DOTS: রোগীর সামনে দাঁড়িয়ে ওষুধ গিলিয়ে খাওয়ানোকে বলে DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment Short-course)।
  • GeneXpert MTB/RIF (আধুনিকতম পরীক্ষা): পুরনো দিনের অণুবীক্ষণ যন্ত্রের বদলে এখন সব উপজেলায় GeneXpert (PCR মেশিন) ব্যবহার করা হয়। মাত্র ২ ঘণ্টার মধ্যে এটি বলে দেয় রোগীর টিবি আছে কি না এবং টিবির প্রধান ওষুধ রিফাম্পিসিন (Rifampicin) কাজ করবে নাকি ওষুধ-প্রতিরোধী MDR-TB হয়েছে (rpoB জিন মিউটেশন দেখে)।
  • চিকিৎসা শিডিউল: সাধারণ টিবির চিকিৎসা ৬ মাস। প্রথম ২ মাস ৪টি ওষুধ (HRZE), পরের ৪ মাস ২টি ওষুধ (HR)।
  • চিকিৎসার ফলাফল (Treatment Outcomes) মনে রাখার ট্রিক:
    • Cured (সম্পূর্ণ নিরাময়): চিকিৎসার শেষ মাসে এবং তার আগে অন্তত একবার কফ পরীক্ষায় জীবাণু নেগেটিভ প্রমাণিত হয়েছে।
    • Treatment Completed: রোগী পুরো কোর্স শেষ করেছে, কিন্তু শেষ মাসের ল্যাব রিপোর্ট পাওয়া যায়নি।
    • Treatment Failed (ব্যর্থতা): চিকিৎসা শুরুর ৫ম মাস বা তার পরেও কফ পরীক্ষায় টিবি জীবাণু পজিটিভ পাওয়া গেছে।
    • Lost to Follow-up: রোগী টানা ২ মাস বা তার বেশি দিন ওষুধ না খেয়ে গায়েব হয়ে গেছে।

442.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 5 (Dengue Syndrome), pp. 272-278; National Guidelines for Clinical Management of Dengue Syndrome 2023, DGHS Bangladesh; WHO Global Strategy for Dengue Prevention.
442.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | AEDES MOSQUITO VECTOR CONTROL & OUTBREAK CONTAINMENT | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [AEDES AEGYPTI (THE TIGER MOSQUITO)] * Day-biter (bites at dawn & dusk). * Breeds exclusively in ARTIFICIAL CONTAINERS of CLEAN, STAGNANT WATER! | +------------------------------+------------------------------+ | | [1. SOURCE REDUCTION (ENVIRONMENTAL)] [2. CHEMICAL VECTOR CONTROL] * "Friday 10 Minutes" Cleanliness Campaign: * Larviciding: Temephos (Abate) 1 ppm empty discarded tyres, plastic pots, drums, or Bti (Bacillus thuringiensis israelensis) coconut shells, flower trays, AC trays! in non-potable artificial reservoirs. * Eliminates 90% of breeding nurseries! * Adulticiding: Thermal fogging (Malathion) & ULV spraying for active flying adults! | v [3. PERSONAL PROTECTION: Permethrin-treated bednets, DEET mosquito repellents, long-sleeved clothes] +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
442.answer:
1. Epidemiology & Transmission of Dengue in Bangladesh: Dengue is an acute arboviral infection caused by four distinct flavivirus serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, DENV-4). Transmitted primarily by the female Aedes aegypti mosquito (urban vector) and secondarily by Aedes albopictus (rural/peri-urban vector). Bangladesh experienced catastrophic outbreaks in recent years, with widespread co-circulation of DENV-2 and DENV-3. 2. Breeding Habits and Bionomics of Aedes aegypti:
  • Domestic & Peridomestic Niche: Highly domesticated mosquito living inside and around human dwellings.
  • Breeding Sites: Breeds almost exclusively in clean, clear, standing, artificial water collections:
    • Discarded motor vehicle tires, plastic buckets, open construction water drums.
    • Flower vase trays, refrigerator drip trays, air conditioner condensation outlets.
    • Discarded plastic food containers, coconut shells, and uncleaned rooftop water tanks.
  • Biting Habits: Strictly a day-biter, with peak biting activity occurring early in the morning (dawn) and late in the afternoon before sunset (dusk). Marked preference for biting around ankles and elbows.
  • Nervous Biter / Multiple Feeding: The mosquito is easily disturbed during feeding and bites multiple individuals within a short period, spreading infection across entire families.
  • Egg Desiccation Resistance: Aedes eggs can withstand complete drying and desiccation for up to 1 year; when rain refills the container, they hatch into larvae within hours!
3. Comprehensive Vector Control Measures: A. Environmental Management & Source Reduction (The Gold Standard): The single most cost-effective and sustainable strategy:
  • Elimination of Artificial Containers: Community-wide mass removal and disposal of solid waste (tires, discarded pots, bottles, coconut shells).
  • Emptying & Scrubbing: Emptying and vigorously scrubbing the inner walls of water storage drums, buckets, and animal water troughs at least once every 7 days (to destroy adhered Aedes eggs and interrupt the 7-10 day aquatic life cycle).
  • Physical Barriers: Tightly fitting mesh screens or covers on all water storage tanks, cisterns, and overhead tanks.
B. Chemical Vector Control:
  • Larviciding: Treating standing non-potable water bodies with organophosphate larvicide Temephos (Abate 1% granules) at 1 ppm (1 g per 1,000 liters) or microbial larvicide Bti (Bacillus thuringiensis israelensis), which selectively lyses larval gut epithelium without harming non-target aquatic organisms.
  • Adulticiding (Emergency Space Spraying):
    • Thermal Fogging: Using fogging machines with pyrethroids or Malathion during epidemic outbreaks to rapidly knock down infected adult female mosquitoes.
    • Ultra-Low Volume (ULV) Aerosol Spraying: Outdoor space spraying performed at dawn and dusk when adult mosquitoes are actively flying.
C. Biological Vector Control: Introducing larvivorous fish (Gambusia affinis / Guppy fish - Poecilia reticulata) into large decorative fountains, cisterns, and drains. 4. Community Engagement and Social Mobilization:
  • "Friday 10 Minutes" Cleanliness Campaign: Engaging households, schools, and offices every Friday morning to dedicate 10 minutes to inspect rooftops, balconies, and AC trays for standing water.
  • School-Based Awareness: Educating schoolchildren as "health ambassadors" to inspect and eliminate breeding pots in their homes.
  • Personal Protection: Using household aerosol knock-down sprays, mosquito coils, insect repellents (DEET or Picaridin on exposed skin), wearing light-colored full-sleeved shirts and trousers, and sleeping under bed nets even during daytime naps.
442.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • ডেঙ্গু ও এডিস মশার বৈশিষ্ট্য (Aedes aegypti - টাইগার মশা):
    1. দিনের বেলা কামড়ায়: সূর্যোদয়ের ২ ঘণ্টা পর এবং সূর্যাস্তের আগে সবচেয়ে বেশি কামড়ায় (Day-biter)।
    2. পরিষ্কার জমা পানিতে ডিম পাড়ে: নর্দমা বা ডোবার পচা পানিতে নয়, বরং ফুলের টব, এসি ও ফ্রিজের ট্রে, গাড়ির টায়ার, প্লাস্টিকের ড্রাম ও ডাবের খোসায় জমে থাকা স্বচ্ছ পানিতে বংশবৃদ্ধি করে।
    3. শুকনোতেও ডিম বাঁচে: এডিস মশার ডিম শুকনো অবস্থায় ১ বছর পর্যন্ত বেঁচে থাকতে পারে! বৃষ্টিতে পানি পাওয়ামাত্র তা ফুটে বাচ্চা বের হয়।
  • ভেক্টর কন্ট্রোল (মশা নিধনের উপায়):
    • Source Reduction (সবচেয়ে কার্যকর): প্রতি সপ্তাহে অন্তত একদিন জমে থাকা পানি ফেলে দেওয়া এবং পাত্রের ভেতরের দেয়াল ঘষে মশার ডিম নষ্ট করা (কারণ ডিম থেকে পূর্ণাঙ্গ মশা হতে ৭-১০ দিন লাগে)।
    • লার্ভিসাইডিং: লার্ভা মারতে পানিতে Temephos (Abate) বা জৈব ব্যাক্টেরিয়া Bti ছিটানো।
    • ফগিং (Thermal Fogging): উড়ন্ত বড় মশা মারতে সকালে ও বিকালে ম্যালাথিয়ন বা পাইরেথ্রয়েড ধোঁয়া দেওয়া।

443.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 6 (Epidemiology of Chronic Non-Communicable Diseases), pp. 385-415; National Multisectoral Action Plan for Prevention and Control of NCDs 2018-2025, DGHS Bangladesh.
443.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | NCD BURDEN & UPAZILA "NCD CORNER" SERVICE ARCHITECTURE | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [EPIDEMIOLOGICAL TRANSITION IN BANGLADESH] * Dual burden: NCDs account for ~67% - 70% of total national deaths! * Big Four NCDs: (1) Cardiovascular Diseases (30%), (2) Cancers (12%), (3) Chronic Respiratory Diseases (10%), (4) Diabetes Mellitus (3%). | v [NCD CORNER IN UPAZILA HEALTH COMPLEXES (UHC)] (Operational hub integrated into the outpatient department of all 492 UHCs) | +------------------------------+------------------------------+ | | [SCREENING & TRIAGE] [PROTOCOLIZED CLINICAL CARE] * Universal screening for ALL patients >= 40 yrs: * Free standardized essential drugs: - Accurate Blood Pressure measurement. - Amlodipine, Losartan, Metformin. - Blood Glucose (Capillary RBS / FBS). * WHO PEN Protocol risk assessment. - Height, Weight, BMI & Waist Circumference. * Tobacco cessation & dietary counseling. - Screening for diabetic retinopathy/neuropathy. * Digital DHIS2 e-tracker registry! +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
443.answer:
1. Epidemiological Burden of Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) in Bangladesh: Bangladesh has undergone an epidemiological transition from infectious diseases to chronic non-communicable diseases. NCDs currently account for an estimated 67% to 70% of all national deaths.
  • The "Big Four" Chronic NCDs:
    1. Cardiovascular Diseases (CVD): Coronary artery disease, stroke, hypertensive heart disease (accounts for ~30% of total deaths).
    2. Cancers: Lung, oral cavity, cervical, breast, esophageal, and gastric malignancies (accounts for ~12%).
    3. Chronic Respiratory Diseases: COPD, asthma, occupational lung diseases (accounts for ~10%).
    4. Diabetes Mellitus: Type 2 diabetes and its micro/macrovascular complications (prevalence ~10-14% in adults).
  • Common Shared Modifiable Risk Factors: Tobacco use (smoking and smokeless Zarda/Gul: ~35% adult prevalence), unhealthy diet (excessive refined carbohydrates, trans-fats, high dietary salt > 9 g/day), physical inactivity, and harmful alcohol use.
2. Prevention and Control Strategies:
  • Population-Wide (Primordial & Primary Prevention): Implementation of the Tobacco Control Act (graphic health warnings, smoking bans in public places, tobacco taxation); mandatory reduction of industrially produced trans-fatty acids (< 2% in fats and oils); national mass-media campaigns on salt reduction (< 5 g/day) and promotion of physical activity.
  • Individual-Level (Early Detection & Universal Access): Integration of the WHO Package of Essential Noncommunicable Disease Interventions (WHO PEN) into the primary healthcare delivery system.
3. Role of "NCD Corners" in Upazila Health Complexes (UHCs): The "NCD Corner" is a specialized, dedicated service unit established within the Outpatient Department (OPD) of all Upazila Health Complexes across Bangladesh, acting as the primary hub for decentralized NCD management:
  1. Opportunistic & Routine Screening: Every outpatient attendee aged 40 years and older (and high-risk individuals aged 18+) is routinely channeled to the NCD Corner for:
    • Standardized blood pressure measurement using validated electronic monitors.
    • Free blood glucose testing using digital glucometers (Capillary FBS/RBS).
    • Measurement of height, weight, Body Mass Index (BMI), and waist circumference.
  2. Cardiovascular Risk Stratification (WHO PEN Chart): Estimating the 10-year risk of a fatal or non-fatal cardiovascular event (Myocardial infarction or stroke) based on age, sex, smoking, systolic BP, and diabetes status.
  3. Free Supply of Essential Standardized Medications: Dispenses standardized, first-line antihypertensive and antidiabetic generic medicines free of charge:
    • Antihypertensives: Amlodipine 5 mg, Losartan potassium 50 mg.
    • Antidiabetics: Metformin 500 mg, Gliclazide 80 mg.
    • Statins: Atorvastatin 10 mg / 20 mg.
  4. Lifestyle & Behavioral Counseling: Dedicated counseling rooms providing face-to-face guidance on DASH diet, salt restriction, tobacco cessation, 30 minutes/day brisk walking, and foot care for diabetics.
  5. Digital Tracking & Longitudinal Electronic Medical Record (DHIS2): Each registered patient is assigned a unique digital NCD ID; clinical parameters, compliance, and follow-up appointments are recorded electronically on the national DHIS2 NCD tracker system.
  6. Timely Referral: Referral of complicated cases (refractory hypertension, diabetic foot ulcers, acute coronary syndromes, suspected malignancies) to District Hospitals and Tertiary Medical College Hospitals.
443.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • বাংলাদেশে অসংক্রামক রোগ (NCD)-এর ভয়াবহ চিত্র: বাংলাদেশে মোট মৃত্যুর ৬৭% থেকে ৭০% মানুষ মারা যায় অসংক্রামক রোগে। এর মধ্যে শীর্ষে রয়েছে হৃদরোগ ও ব্রেন স্ট্রোক (৩০%), ক্যান্সার (১২%), শ্বাসকষ্ট/COPD (১০%) এবং ডায়াবেটিস। প্রধান রিস্ক ফ্যাক্টর: তামাক/জর্দা-গুল, খাবারে অতিরিক্ত কাঁচা লবণ এবং অলস জীবনযাপন।
  • উপজেলা স্বাস্থ্য কমপ্লেক্সের "NCD কর্নার" (NCD Corner): উপজেলা হাসপাতালের বহির্বিভাগে প্রতিষ্ঠিত বিশেষায়িত কর্নার যা গ্রামীণ পর্যায়ে ডায়াবেটিস ও উচ্চ রক্তচাপের চিকিৎসায় যুগান্তকারী ভূমিকা রাখছে।
  • NCD কর্নারের প্রধান ৫টি কাজ:
    1. বিনামূল্যে স্ক্রিনিং: ৪০ বছর বা তদূর্ধ্ব সব রোগীর প্রেশার মাপা, রক্তে সুগার মাপা এবং ওজন ও বিএমআই (BMI) মাপা।
    2. বিনামূল্যে ওষুধ বিতরণ: প্রেশারের ওষুধ (Amlodipine, Losartan), ডায়াবেটিসের ওষুধ (Metformin) এবং কোলেস্টেরলের ওষুধ বিনামূল্যে দেওয়া।
    3. কাউন্সেলিং: কাঁচা লবণ ছাড়ানো, ধূমপান/জর্দা বন্ধ এবং প্রতিদিন অন্তত ৩০ মিনিট দ্রুত হাঁটার পরামর্শ দেওয়া।
    4. ডিজিটাল ট্র্যাকিং: প্রতিটি রোগীকে ডিজিটাল আইডি দিয়ে সফটওয়্যারে (DHIS2) রেকর্ড রাখা যাতে ফলো-আপ নিশ্চিত করা যায়।

444.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 5 (Epidemiology of Communicable Diseases: Malaria), pp. 260-272; National Malaria Elimination Programme (NMEP) Strategic Plan 2021-2025, DGHS Bangladesh.
444.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | NATIONAL MALARIA ELIMINATION PROGRAMME (NMEP) BANGLADESH | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [GEOGRAPHICAL STRATIFICATION: 13 ENDEMIC DISTRICTS] * HIGH ENDEMIC ZONE: The 3 Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) Districts: - Bandarban (Highest burden!), Rangamati, Khagrachhari (+ Cox's Bazar). - Vector: Forest-breeding Anopheles baimaii (dirus) & An. minimus. | v [EARLY DIAGNOSIS: Bivalent Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT: Pf & Pv) + Microscopy] | +---------------------------+---------------------------+ | | [PLASMODIUM FALCIPARUM (90%)] [PLASMODIUM VIVAX (10%)] * ARTEMISININ-BASED COMBINATION THERAPY: * Chloroquine (25 mg base/kg over 3 days) - Oral Artemether + Lumefantrine (AL) for 3 days. * PLUS PRIMAQUINE (0.25 mg/kg daily for 14 days) - Single-dose PRIMAQUINE (0.25 mg/kg) on Day 1 to eradicate HYPNOZOITES & prevent relapse! as a Gametocytocidal agent to block transmission! (Check for G6PD deficiency before 14-day course!) +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
444.answer:
1. High-Endemic Districts & Target in Bangladesh: Under the National Malaria Elimination Programme (NMEP), Bangladesh is on track for nationwide malaria elimination:
  • Malaria is focalized across 13 endemic border districts, but over 90% of the national malaria burden is concentrated in the 3 Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) districts:
    1. Bandarban (Highest transmission zone; accounts for the majority of deaths and severe malaria).
    2. Rangamati.
    3. Khagrachhari.
    4. (Cox's Bazar also has localized transmission in forest fringes).
  • Primary Vector: Forest-dwelling, shade-loving Anopheles baimaii (formerly An. dirus) and Anopheles minimus breeding in forest streams.
  • Parasite Species: Plasmodium falciparum accounts for ~90% of infections; Plasmodium vivax accounts for ~10%.
2. Artemisinin-Based Combination Therapy (ACT) Protocol: Because P. falciparum in South-East Asia has long-standing resistance to chloroquine and sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine, ACT is the mandatory first-line treatment in Bangladesh:
  • First-Line Drug for Uncomplicated P. falciparum Malaria:
    • Artemether + Lumefantrine (AL) Fixed-Dose Combination: Administered as a 6-dose regimen over 3 days (given at 0, 8, 24, 36, 48, and 60 hours) taken with fatty food/milk to enhance lumefantrine bioavailability.
      Mechanism: Artemether produces rapid, massive reduction of parasite biomass within 24-48 hours, while the long-acting partner drug Lumefantrine eradicates residual parasites, preventing recrudescence and preventing emergence of artemisinin resistance.
    • Gametocytocidal Single-Dose Primaquine: Administer Primaquine 0.25 mg base/kg orally as a single stat dose on Day 1.
      Crucial Public Health Rationale: Artemisinin derivatives kill asexual blood schizonts but do not rapidly kill mature stage V gametocytes. Primaquine is a potent gametocide that sterilizes sexual gametocytes within hours, completely preventing transmission to mosquitoes!
  • Treatment of Severe / Complicated Malaria (Cerebral Malaria): Intravenous Artesunate (2.4 mg/kg IV stat at 0, 12, and 24 hours, then daily) until the patient can swallow, followed by a full 3-day oral course of ACT.
  • Treatment of P. vivax Malaria (Anti-Relapse Therapy): Chloroquine (total 25 mg/kg over 3 days) PLUS Primaquine 0.25 mg base/kg daily for 14 days to destroy dormant liver hypnozoites and achieve radical cure (screen for G6PD deficiency).
3. Vector Control in High-Endemic CHT: Universal free mass distribution of Long-Lasting Insecticidal Nets (LLINs) impregnated with pyrethroids (1 LLIN per 2 persons), replaced every 3 years; focal indoor residual spraying (IRS).
444.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • বাংলাদেশে ম্যালেরিয়ার প্রধান এলাকা: দেশের ৯০% এর বেশি ম্যালেরিয়া রোগী পাওয়া যায় পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামের ৩টি জেলায়—বান্দরবান (সবচেয়ে বেশি), রাঙ্গামাটি এবং খাগড়াছড়ি। প্রধান পরজীবী: Plasmodium falciparum (৯০%)।
  • প্রথম সারির চিকিৎসা (ACT প্রোটোকল):
    1. Artemether + Lumefantrine (AL): ৩ দিনে মোট ৬টি ডোজ খেতে হয় (ফ্যালসিপেরাম ম্যালেরিয়ার জন্য)। এটি ফ্যাটজাতীয় খাবার বা দুধের সাথে খেলে ভালো কাজ করে।
    2. Primaquine (এক ডোজ): ১ম দিনে প্রিমাকুইন ০.২৫ মিগ্রা/কেজি এক ডোজ খেতে দেওয়া হয়। এটি রক্তের গ্যামেটোসাইট (Gametocyte) ধ্বংস করে, ফলে মশা রক্ত চুষলেও অন্য মানুষের মধ্যে রোগ ছড়াতে পারে না (Transmission blocker)।
  • ভাইভ্যাক্স (P. vivax) ম্যালেরিয়ার চিকিৎসা: ক্লোরোকুইন ৩ দিন + প্রিমাকুইন টানা ১৪ দিন খেতে হয়, যাতে লিভারে লুকিয়ে থাকা হিপনোজয়েট (Hypnozoites) ধ্বংস হয়ে ভবিষ্যতে আর কখনো ম্যালেরিয়া ফিরে না আসে (Radical cure)।
  • মস্তিষ্কের মারাত্মক ম্যালেরিয়া (Cerebral Malaria): জীবনরক্ষাকারী ওষুধ হলো ইনজেকশন আর্টেসুনেট (IV Artesunate)।

445.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 5 (Visceral Leishmaniasis / Kala-azar), pp. 290-296; National Kala-azar Elimination Programme Guidelines, DGHS Bangladesh; WHO Leishmaniasis Country Profiles.
445.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | KALA-AZAR ELIMINATION FRAMEWORK IN BANGLADESH | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [HISTORIC ENDEMIC BELT: Mymensingh, Jamalpur, Tangail, Pabna, Sirajganj] | v [ACTIVE CASE SEARCH METHODOLOGIES] * Index Case Camp Search / Snowball Search: Screen all households within 500m of an index case. * Kala-azar Search Camp (KSC) in villages with fever > 2 weeks & splenomegaly. | v [RAPID POINT-OF-CARE DIAGNOSIS] * rK39 Immunochromatographic Dipstick Strip Test (Sensitivity > 98%, Specificity > 90%). | v [FIRST-LINE REVOLUTIONARY TREATMENT: SINGLE-DOSE AMBISOME] * Liposomal Amphotericin B (AmBisome): 10 mg/kg IV single infusion over 2 hours! * Cure rate > 98-99%, zero nephrotoxicity compared to conventional sodium stibogluconate! +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
445.answer:
1. Historical Context & The Elimination Miracle: Visceral Leishmaniasis (Kala-azar), caused by Leishmania donovani and transmitted by the female sandfly Phlebotomus argentipes, was historically a major public health scourge across the alluvial plains of Bangladesh (especially Mymensingh, Jamalpur, Tangail, Pabna). Through intense bilateral political commitment, Bangladesh became the first country in the world to be formally validated by the WHO for eliminating Kala-azar as a public health problem (achieving < 1 case per 10,000 population at the Upazila level). 2. Active Case Search Strategies: Because passive surveillance leaves hidden infectious reservoirs in remote villages, the national program deployed active case searches:
  1. Camp Approach (Kala-azar Search Camps): Organized in high-risk villages where community health workers mobilize all persons with fever of > 2 weeks duration not responding to antimalarials/antibiotics, accompanied by splenomegaly. On-site testing with rK39 strip test.
  2. Index Case-Triggered Search (Snowball / Focal Search): Whenever a new index case of Kala-azar or Post-Kala-azar Dermal Leishmaniasis (PKDL) is identified, a surveillance team visits the village and screens all family members and neighbors within a 500-meter radius.
  3. Incentivized Community Case Detection: Providing financial incentives to village healthcare volunteers for every confirmed Kala-azar case brought to the Upazila Health Complex.
3. Rapid Point-of-Care Diagnosis (The rK39 Strip Test):
  • An immunochromatographic dipstick test detecting circulating antibodies against the recombinant 39-amino acid kinesin-like protein antigen of Leishmania donovani (rK39).
  • Requires only a drop of capillary fingerstick blood; delivers a qualitative visual color-band result within 10 to 15 minutes with > 98% sensitivity and > 90% specificity. Replaced dangerous splenic aspirates!
4. The Single-Dose AmBisome Protocol (First-Line Therapy): The introduction of single-dose liposomal amphotericin B revolutionized visceral leishmaniasis treatment:
  • Drug & Formulation: Liposomal Amphotericin B (AmBisome). The liposomal lipid vehicle targets the drug specifically to the reticuloendothelial macrophages of the liver, spleen, and bone marrow where Leishmania amastigotes replicate.
  • Dosage & Administration: Administered as a single intravenous infusion of 10 mg/kg body weight diluted in 5% Dextrose, infused over 2 hours.
  • Therapeutic Advantages:
    • Replaced the painful 28-day daily intramuscular injections of toxic sodium stibogluconate (SSG).
    • Cure rate exceeds 98% to 99% with virtually zero relapses.
    • Extremely safe; negligible nephrotoxicity or infusion reactions. 100% treatment compliance achieved on day one.
  • Post-Kala-azar Dermal Leishmaniasis (PKDL) Monitoring: PKDL patients present with hypopigmented macules, papules, or nodules months/years after cure; they serve as a critical asymptomatic transmission reservoir and are treated with Miltefosine or multi-dose AmBisome.
445.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • কালাজ্বর নির্মূলে বাংলাদেশের ঐতিহাসিক সাফল্য: বাংলাদেশ বিশ্বের প্রথম দেশ হিসেবে বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থা (WHO) কর্তৃক কালাজ্বর নির্মূলের আন্তর্জাতিক স্বীকৃতি অর্জন করেছে (উপজেলা পর্যায়ে প্রতি ১০,০০০ মানুষের মধ্যে ১ জনেরও কম রোগী)। কালাজ্বরের জীবাণু ছড়ায় বেলেমাছি (Sandfly - Phlebotomus argentipes)।
  • Active Case Search (সক্রিয় রোগী সন্ধান): ঘরে বসে না থেকে গ্রামে গিয়ে ক্যাম্প করে যাদের ২ সপ্তাহের বেশি জ্বর ও প্লীহা বড় (Splenomegaly) তাদের আঙুল থেকে ১ ফোঁটা রক্ত নিয়ে rK39 স্ট্রিপ টেস্ট করা। ১০ মিনিটেই রেজাল্ট পাওয়া যায়।
  • এক ডোজের জাদুকরী চিকিৎসা - AmBisome: পূর্বে ২৮ দিন ধরে বিষাক্ত ইনজেকশন দিতে হতো। এখন মাত্র ১ ডোজে Liposomal Amphotericin B (AmBisome 10 mg/kg IV) স্যালাইনের মাধ্যমে ২ ঘণ্টায় দিলে ৯৮-৯৯% রোগী সম্পূর্ণ সুস্থ হয়ে যায়!
  • PKDL (Post-Kala-azar Dermal Leishmaniasis): কালাজ্বর ভালো হওয়ার কয়েকমাস পর ত্বকে সাদা ছোপ ছোপ দাগ বা দানা ওঠে। এই রোগীদের ত্বকে প্রচুর জীবাণু থাকে এবং তারা বেলেমাছির মাধ্যমে অন্যদের মাঝে রোগ ছড়ায়, তাই এদের চিকিৎসা করা অত্যন্ত জরুরি।

446.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 5 (Coronavirus Disease 2019 / COVID-19), pp. 315-325; National Preparedness and Response Plan for COVID-19, DGHS Bangladesh; IEDCR Bulletins.
446.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | COVID-19 MULTI-PRONGED PANDEMIC CONTAINMENT SPECTRUM | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [POINTS OF ENTRY SURVEILLANCE & TRIAGE] * International airports / land ports: Thermal scanners, mandatory RT-PCR verification. | v [ISOLATION & QUARANTINE PROTOCOLS] * Institutional Quarantine (14 days) -> Transitioned to 7-10 day home quarantine for exposed. * Dedicated isolation beds & central liquid oxygen plants in all District & Medical College Hospitals. | v [SURVEILLANCE & LABORATORY EXPANSION] * Expanded from 1 lab (IEDCR) to 150+ RT-PCR & Rapid Antigen Testing labs nationwide! | v [NATIONWIDE VACCINATION DRIVE ("SUROKKHA" PLATFORM)] * National registration portal: Surokkha.gov.bd linked with National ID (NID). * Over 130+ million citizens vaccinated (> 88% of eligible population!). * Vaccine portfolio: Astra-Zeneca, Sinopharm, Pfizer-BioNTech, Moderna. +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
446.answer:
1. Public Health Surveillance & Laboratory Decentralization: Following the declaration of the COVID-19 pandemic by WHO in March 2020, Bangladesh mobilized the National Preparedness and Response Plan (NPRP) under the leadership of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MOHFW) and IEDCR:
  • Laboratory Scale-Up: Testing expanded rapidly from a single reference laboratory at IEDCR (Dhaka) to a decentralized network of over 150 molecular RT-PCR laboratories and countrywide Rapid Antigen Testing hubs at every Upazila Health Complex.
  • Syndromic Surveillance & Hotlines: National 24/7 dedicated hotlines (16263, 333, and IEDCR hotlines) fielded millions of queries, enabling remote triaging, home monitoring of mild cases, and dispatching mobile sample collection teams.
  • Genomic Surveillance: Routine next-generation viral whole-genome sequencing (coordinated by IEDCR, Child Health Research Foundation, and icddr,b) tracking variant transitions (Wuhan wild type $\rightarrow$ Alpha $\rightarrow$ Beta $\rightarrow$ Delta $\rightarrow$ Omicron sub-lineages).
2. Quarantine, Isolation, and Clinical Triage:
  • Border Control & Quarantine: Thermal screening at international airports and sea/land ports; mandatory 14-day institutional quarantine in designated facilities (e.g., Hajj Camp Ashkona) for travelers arriving from high-risk countries.
  • Community Containment: Contact tracing of confirmed cases; zoned lockdowns ("Red, Yellow, Green zones") based on rolling 14-day case incidence.
  • Hospital Infrastructure Transformation: Conversion of major facilities (e.g., DNCC Dedicated COVID-19 Hospital, Kurmitola General Hospital) into dedicated isolation centers; installation of Central Liquid Medical Oxygen (LMO) plants across all District Hospitals and Medical Colleges to avert hypoxemic deaths.
3. Nationwide Vaccination Campaign (The "Surokkha" Digital Infrastructure): Bangladesh executed one of the most successful mass COVID-19 vaccination campaigns among developing nations, achieving over 88% coverage of the targeted population (> 130 million fully vaccinated individuals):
  • The "Surokkha" Digital Platform (www.surokkha.gov.bd): An automated, cloud-based national registration portal integrated directly with the national citizen database (National ID / NID, Birth Certificate, or Passport). It scheduled appointments via automated SMS, issued digital verification QR-code vaccine certificates, and automated booster dose scheduling.
  • Phased Priority Rollout:
    1. Phase 1: Frontline healthcare workers, law enforcement, armed forces, journalists, and citizens aged $\ge$ 65 years.
    2. Phase 2: Progressive reduction of age eligibility (55 $\rightarrow$ 40 $\rightarrow$ 30 $\rightarrow$ 18 $\rightarrow$ 12-17 years for school students $\rightarrow$ 5-11 years for children).
    3. Special Populations: Ready-Made Garment (RMG) factory workers, university students, and Rohingya refugees in Cox's Bazar.
  • Vaccine Portfolio Diversity: Deployed a diversified multi-platform vaccine portfolio acquired through bilateral procurement and the global COVAX facility: Oxford-AstraZeneca (ChAdOx1), Sinopharm / Sinovac (Inactivated), Pfizer-BioNTech & Moderna (mRNA platform stored in ultra-cold freezers at -80°C).

  • বাংলাদেশে করোনা (COVID-19) মহামারী মোকাবিলার ৩টি প্রধান স্তম্ভ:
    1. ল্যাব নেটওয়ার্ক ও নজরদারি: শুরুতে শুধু IEDCR-এ ১টি ল্যাব ছিল, যা পরবর্তীতে সারাদেশে ১৫০টিরও বেশি আরটি-পিসিআর (RT-PCR) এবং সব উপজেলায় র‌্যাপিড অ্যান্টিজেন টেস্ট ল্যাবে রূপান্তর করা হয়। হটলাইন ১৬২৬৩ এবং ৩৩৩ দিয়ে টেলিমেডিসিন দেওয়া হয়।
    2. আইসোলেশন ও সেন্ট্রাল অক্সিজেন: করোনা ডেডিকেটেড হাসপাতাল তৈরি এবং সব জেলা হাসপাতালে সেন্ট্রাল লিকুইড অক্সিজেন (LMO) প্ল্যান্ট স্থাপন।
    3. টিকা কর্মসূচির জাতীয় সাফল্য (সুরক্ষা প্ল্যাটফর্ম): "সুরক্ষা" (surokkha.gov.bd) অ্যাপের মাধ্যমে জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র (NID) দিয়ে বিশ্বমানের ডিজিটাল রেজিস্ট্রেশন ও কিউআর কোডযুক্ত সার্টিফিকেট প্রদান করা হয়। দেশের ৮৮%-এর বেশি মানুষকে টিকার আওতায় আনা হয় (অ্যাস্ট্রাজেনেকা, সিনোফার্ম, ফাইজার, মডার্না)।

447.textbook: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 27th ed., Ch. 6 (Non-Communicable Diseases Surveillance: WHO STEPS Approach), pp. 385-392; WHO STEPS Surveillance Manual (The WHO STEPwise Approach to Chronic Disease Risk Factor Surveillance).
447.diagram: +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | THE THREE STEPS OF THE WHO STEPS SURVEILLANCE APPROACH | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ [WHO STEPS NCD SURVEILLANCE] | +-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+ | | | [STEP 1: QUESTIONNAIRE] [STEP 2: PHYSICAL MEASURE] [STEP 3: BIOCHEMICAL] * Behavioral risk factors: * Anthropometric & vitals: * Laboratory biomarkers: - Tobacco use (smoking/smokeless) - Blood Pressure (systolic/diast) - Fasting blood glucose (FBS) - Alcohol consumption - Height, Weight & BMI (diabetes/impaired fasting) - Diet (fruits/veg & salt intake) - Waist circumference (central - Total cholesterol & HDL - Physical activity (GPAQ score) obesity marker). (atherogenic dyslipidemia). | | | v v v [Low Cost / Mass Population] [Moderate Cost / Clinic Based] [Highest Cost / Lab Based] +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
447.answer:
1. Definition & Strategic Concept: The WHO STEPS Approach (STEPwise approach to Surveillance of Non-communicable Disease Risk Factors) is a standardized, sequential surveillance framework developed by the World Health Organization to help countries collect, analyze, and monitor reliable core risk factor data for chronic non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, cancer, chronic respiratory disease).
Core Rationale: Large-scale clinical outcomes (e.g., myocardial infarction, stroke) are preceded by years of covert behavioral and biological risk factors. Monitoring these upstream risk factors provides early warning intelligence to guide public health interventions. 2. The Three Sequential Steps: The methodology is organized into three sequential "steps" progressing from simple questionnaire-based interviews to physical measurements, and finally to biochemical blood testing:
  1. STEP 1: Questionnaire-Based Behavioral Risk Factor Assessment: A structured, standardized face-to-face questionnaire administered by trained field workers in community households.
    • Core Domains Evaluated:
      1. Tobacco Use: Current smoking status, duration, daily cigarette count, and use of smokeless tobacco (Zarda, Gul, Sada pata).
      2. Alcohol Consumption: Lifetime drinking, past 30-day frequency, and binge drinking episodes.
      3. Dietary Habits: Average daily servings of fresh fruits and vegetables (< 5 standard servings / 400 g per day represents deficiency); daily discretionary salt intake.
      4. Physical Activity: Quantified using the Global Physical Activity Questionnaire (GPAQ) across work, travel, and recreational domains (calculating MET-minutes per week).
    • Characteristics: Low cost, rapid execution, accessible to all developing countries.
  2. STEP 2: Physical & Anthropometric Measurements: Objective physical clinical measurements taken directly on participants using calibrated portable equipment:
    • Blood Pressure: Three consecutive sitting blood pressure readings using validated digital sphygmomanometers (recording systolic and diastolic BP, calculating hypertension prevalence: BP $\ge$ 140/90 mmHg).
    • Heart Rate: Resting pulse rate.
    • Height and Weight: Measured with portable stadiometers and digital weighing scales to calculate Body Mass Index (BMI = $kg/m^2$): Asian cutoff criteria (Overweight: $\ge$ 23 $kg/m^2$; Obese: $\ge$ 25 $kg/m^2$).
    • Waist Circumference: Measured at the midpoint between the lower rib margin and the iliac crest (identifies central visceral obesity: Asian cutoffs > 90 cm in men, > 80 cm in women).
    • Characteristics: Moderate cost; provides objective physiological baseline.
  3. STEP 3: Biochemical & Laboratory Blood Measurements: Involves obtaining biological specimens (fasting venous or capillary fingerstick blood) after an overnight fast (8-12 hours):
    • Fasting Blood Glucose (FBS): Detects impaired fasting glucose and diabetes mellitus (FBS $\ge$ 7.0 mmol/L / 126 mg/dL).
    • Lipid Profile: Total cholesterol, HDL-cholesterol, and calculated LDL/triglycerides (identifies atherogenic dyslipidemia: total cholesterol $\ge$ 5.0 mmol/L / 190 mg/dL).
    • Urinary Sodium & Creatinine: 24-hour urine collection or spot urine to estimate average population salt intake.
    • Characteristics: Highest cost and logistical complexity; reserved for subsamples or well-resourced national surveys.
3. Applied Public Health Value: Provides national governments with high-quality, internationally comparable trend data (e.g., the Bangladesh National STEPS Survey 2018) to evaluate national NCD action plans, evaluate the impact of tobacco taxes, and allocate healthcare budget to NCD corners and primary health facilities.
447.bangla:
বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও পরীক্ষার গোল্ডেন পয়েন্ট:
  • WHO STEPS অ্যাপ্রোচ (অসংক্রামক রোগের ঝুঁকি পরিমাপের ৩টি ধাপ):
    1. Step 1 (Questionnaire - প্রশ্নমালা): ঘরে ঘরে গিয়ে রোগীর জীবনযাত্রার তথ্য নেওয়া:
      • ধূমপান বা জর্দা-গুল খায় কি না।
      • অ্যালকোহল গ্রহণ করে কি না।
      • খাবারে শাকসবজি ও ফলমূল কম খায় কি না এবং অতিরিক্ত কাঁচা লবণ খায় কি না।
      • দৈহিক পরিশ্রম বা হাঁটাচলা (Physical inactivity) করে কি না।
    2. Step 2 (Physical measurements - শারীরিক পরিমাপ): রোগীর কাছে গিয়ে সরাসরি ফিজিক্যাল মাপজোখ নেওয়া:
      • রক্তচাপ মাপা (Blood Pressure $\ge$ 140/90 mmHg)।
      • উচ্চতা ও ওজন মেপে বিএমআই (BMI) বের করা (এশীয়দের জন্য $\ge$ ২৫ মানে স্থূলতা/Obese)।
      • কোমরের পরিধি (Waist circumference) মেপে পেটের মেদ দেখা (পুরুষ > ৯০ সেমি, নারী > ৮০ সেমি)।
    3. Step 3 (Biochemical measurements - রক্ত পরীক্ষা): ল্যাবরেটরিতে খালি পেটের রক্ত পরীক্ষা:
      • Fasting Blood Glucose (খালি পেটে ডায়াবেটিসের সুগার লেভেল)।
      • Lipid Profile (রক্তে চর্বি বা কোলেস্টেরলের মাত্রা)।
      • প্রস্রাবে সোডিয়ামের মাত্রা দেখে লবণ খাওয়ার পরিমাণ নির্ধারণ।
  • উপকারিতা: স্ট্রোক বা হার্ট অ্যাটাক হওয়ার অনেক আগেই জনগোষ্ঠীর কোন কোন ঝুঁকি বেড়ে যাচ্ছে তা আগাম টের পেয়ে সরকারি নীতি নির্ধারণে সাহায্য করে।
